edit.description: readPendingTolerant's probe (:3991) → existsLoud in a catch that warns before returning `[]`
unstattable-queue case for the post-tick re-read

summary: readPendingTolerant warns on a stat failure instead of silently reading an empty queue, matching the parse-failure branch in the same function
tests: readPendingTolerant warns naming the stat error when pending.json is present but unstattable
acceptance: An unstattable queue on the post-tick re-read is announced, not swallowed: the degraded-but-proceeding path is declared and its warn fires, instead of `pendingAfter` reading as a drained queue with nothing said.
notes: The strict twin (`readPending`, :3949) refuses via existsLoud; this one cannot throw — it runs after the tick's work landed, so a throw loses the TickResult. Warn-then-`[]` is the symmetric fix: the parse branch six lines below already does exactly that. pendingAfter feeds chain.ts's hibernate call (`pickableAfter.length > 0`), so a silent `[]` sleeps the loop over a queue never read. ELOOP via symlink is the fixture idiom (tests/git.test.ts:714).

edit.description: the bare resolveRepoRoot call (:155) gains the try/catch → EX_IOERR its sibling probes use
real-CLI case: unstattable ancestor `.flume`, beside the existing state-root-guard mapping test

summary: Map resolveRepoRoot's stat throw to EX_IOERR with a `[flume]` message at its cli.ts callsite, instead of a raw stack and exit 1 via main().catch
tests: flume exits EX_IOERR naming the stat error when an ancestor .flume is present but unstattable
acceptance: The walk's refusal is classifiable from the exit status like every other stat refusal in the CLI, rather than an unclassified 1 with a stack dump on stderr.
notes: Called bare at src/cli.ts:155, ahead of every try/catch in main(). Sibling stat refusals exit 74 with `[flume] ...` (cli.ts:299, 349, 378, 410). EX_IOERR, not EX_UNAVAILABLE: the failing op is the stat, and the EX_IOERR doc at cli.ts:105 already names this exact class. Copy the shape of tests/cliJobResolution.test.ts:726.
